jobs.title: Social Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Spotify is looking for an exceptional Social Marketing Manager to lead our social marketing efforts across the UK and Ireland, while providing strategic oversight and guidance for the Netherlands market. We're seeking a social-first marketer with a deep passion for music culture, audience behaviour, and storytelling — someone who can think strategically while also driving day-to-day execution across channels.

You bring a proven track record of developing impactful social strategies, creating culturally resonant content, and building engaged communities. You understand platform dynamics, know how to identify opportunities within emerging trends, and can translate audience insights into compelling campaigns that drive engagement, growth, and brand affinity.

In this role, you'll collaborate across Marketing, Music, Podcasts, Audiobooks, PR & Communications, Artist Partnerships, and local market teams to bring Spotify to life for fans across multiple markets. You'll help position Spotify at the center of culture, connecting audiences with the artists, creators, and experiences they love.

What You'll Do

-

Oversee the planning and execution of a dynamic social media content strategy for the UK and Ireland, leveraging platforms to build community, spark conversation, and increase brand engagement with relevant audiences. Identify trends, optimise content for each platform, and collaborate with influencers and creators to expand reach.

-

Manage our key agency partner fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, and accountability. Ensure high-quality execution that aligns with the brand’s vision and strategic goals.

-

Optimise with the use of paid media.

-

Provide strategic oversight and direction for the Netherlands social marketing, ensuring alignment with broader global brand strategy, sharing best practices, and supporting cross-market campaign activations.

-

Participate in the adaptation, creation and execution of innovative, multi-channel marketing campaigns that amplify our brand, content, and partnerships across all three markets.

-

Collaborate closely with our Music and Podcast team to ensure that all content created for our brand is culturally relevant and adheres to our channel guidelines. Develop a keen understanding of the local music community, industry and fans, particularly the nuances of UK and Irish music culture, audience sensibilities, and social behaviour.

-

Define and strengthen our brand identity, ensuring consistency across all marketing touchpoints. Develop culturally resonant campaigns and initiatives that reflect our commitment to diversity, music discovery, and audience connection.

-

Build and nurture relationships with creators and relevant players in the UK and Irish cultural landscape to expand the platform’s reach.

-

Harness data insights to drive engagement with key audience segments, especially Gen Z. Analyse marketing performance metrics to measure ROI, identify opportunities, and optimise campaigns. Stay dialled in to social sentiment and report trends to key stakeholders.

-

Stay informed of industry trends, emerging platforms, and audience behaviour to adapt strategies as needed.

-

Lead on social roll out across live experiences and hero campaigns across both paid and organic
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

-

7+ years in social marketing, ideally within the music, entertainment, or content industries.

-

A strong sense of brand identity and creative vision, with the ability to present and advocate for ideas effectively.

-

Deep knowledge of UK social media culture and audience behaviour — including an understanding of how UK and Irish consumers engage with content across platforms, the cultural moments and conversations that resonate.

-

Demonstrable experience managing social channels for a market, with a clear grasp of regional differences in content preference, platform usage, and engagement patterns.

-

Proven ability to cultivate strong, trusting, and transparent working relationships at all levels of an organisation.

-

Thrive in fast-paced, high-pressure environments, managing tight deadlines, shifting priorities, and real-time decision-making with ease.

-

Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented, with a collaborative mindset to navigate ambiguity and evolving situations effectively.

-

Well-versed in the music industry, including emerging trends, influential artists, and cultural movements, particularly within UK and Irish music scenes.

-

Experience working across international markets or with culturally diverse teams; experience with or knowledge of the Netherlands or Benelux market is a plus.

-

A genuine passion for music, coupled with a strong awareness of cultural trends and dynamics.

Where You'll Be

-

This role is based in London.

-

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

- We ask that you come into the London office 3 times per week.

jobs.title: Corporate Communications Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Spotify’s Global Communications team is seeking a Corporate Communications Senior Manager, who will support the Global Corporate Communications team in issues management and safeguarding and enhancing Spotify’s brand reputation across markets. The ideal candidate will have experience in corporate communications; has worked with media and creators; and is a determined self-starter who can thrive in a fast-paced, complex organization.

The senior manager will help support regional market teams around the world in handling sensitive issues and managing narratives as needed. You will work with global teams to help develop and coordinate strategic, integrated communications plans and narratives, utilizing a mix of earned, owned, paid, and social channels. The ideal candidate will have previous experience in global tech companies, be a true team player while accomplishing work autonomously, and bring a proactive approach to their work.

What You'll Do

-

Lead planning and execution of fully-fledged 360° plans across media types and channels to elevate our corporate stories, aligned and embedded into our local and regional business objectives.

-

Support the team’s proactive and reactive media relations, and continue building strong relationships with key business, music, and technology press.

-

Craft compelling narratives and messaging around Spotify’s local, regional, and global business strategies.

-

Proactively monitor critical issues relevant to Spotify’s business operations, brand, and reputation and help prepare mitigation and response plans.

-

Collaborate cross-functionally with several teams across the company at varying levels across regions and markets.

-

Monitor and analyze media coverage to provide insights and recommendations.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

-

You have 8+ years of experience working in technology, product or media industries on corporate communications.

-

You possess a strong understanding of the global media landscape and have established pre-existing relationships with key business and tech media and content creators.

-

You have a proven track record of successful media relations and securing high-impact coverage.

-

You are proactive and results-oriented. You can work efficiently in a fast-paced environment under pressure without sacrificing attention to detail.

-

You are a strong collaborator, team player, and self-motivated, independent worker with a hands-on approach and the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

-

Established experience coordinating across multi-layered corporate and sensitive projects.

-

A strong written and verbal communicator who is fluent in AI tools.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in London, UK

-

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

-

We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. jobs.title: Associate Manager, Marketing Science
jobs.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts.

Spotify is a leading global music streaming platform that provides over half a billion users with access to an extensive library of songs, podcasts, and audio content. We are looking for a new team member to join our advertising band. As a Marketing Science Associate Manager, you will play a crucial role in developing our advertising business through the creation of audience insights and application of measurement studies for brands and agencies.

What You’ll Do

- Shape, drive and execute on research and measurement strategy across key verticals in North America

- Consult with advertising partners on measurement strategy and solutions, with strong expertise across performance measurement and conversion-lift measurement tactics

- Create and deliver measurement-driven projects that align with vertical and market initiatives, with a constant focus on driving growth and revenue

- Propel the adoption of Spotify’s first-party measurement solutions and act as a subject matter expert on those solutions internally and externally

- Partner with our Product team and provide expertise as it relates to measurement methodology, particularly for attribution and low-funnel measurement

- Build compelling, multi-source, advertising research stories that educate our sellers, marketers and clients and tout Spotify’s unique value proposition

- Extract insights from large and diversified data sets (1st party and custom research) to provide hypotheses, and use insights to answer sales, marketing, and business development questions

- Partner closely with Sales and other cross-functional partners to create scalable solutions tailored to specific client needs

- Develop new, innovative approaches to data analysis and positioning and strong recommendations that feed into future client strategies

- Evaluate effectiveness across Spotify buying channels to share recommendations, success stories, and best practices

- Influence stakeholders and change behavior to improve business outcomes

- Educate internal and external stakeholders on media performance trends and best practices to inform business decisions across our business

- Contribute to Spotify’s point of view regarding new/current research and measurement solutions, and educate our Sales and Marketing teams accordingly

- Present measurement insights at client, agency, and industry events as needed

- Partner cross-functionally to identify and outline top performing campaign tactics, including Spotify formats, audiences, and buying channels, to publish as success stories

- Collaborate with leadership stakeholders on Sales and/or Marketing initiatives
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- You have 5+ years of experience in digital advertising research at a research vendor, media owner, advertiser or agency partner.

- You have excellent presentation skills and ability to lead and significantly contribute to external meetings with clients

- You have proven experience partnering with global advertisers and driving measurement strategy in a given expertise area

- You operate in a transparent fashion to stakeholders and peers, and viewed as approachable regarding challenging talks

- You have a strong background in quantitative ad effectiveness research, particularly with using conversion-lift solutions and other low-funnel measurement products

- You have experience with scaling signal-based solutions such as conversions API

- You are familiar with interpreting results and recommending measurement solutions that include, but are not limited to, driving app installs/in-app activity, multi-touch attribution, conversions APIs, clean rooms, and more

- You have a high level of experience in running multiple-forms of advertising measurement ranging from brand lift to conversion lift measurement across a variety of buying channels, including Programmatic channels

- You are extremely strong knowledge of the digital marketing ecosystem, measurement capability landscape, and how it all works from a technical perspective

- You have extensive experience in data analysis and storytelling, going beyond the “what” to tell the “why” within research results

- You are self-starter who digs into projects without needing much direction

- You have a positive and collaborative teammate who values building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders

Where You’ll Be

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the US region as long as we have a work location.

- This team operates across PST and EST time zones for collaboration.

The United States base range for this position is $98,347 - 140,495, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Content Platform team powers the full lifecycle of content across music, podcasts, audiobooks, and emerging formats at Spotify. We ensure that everything from licensed catalog to user-generated content is understood, trusted, safe, and high quality for millions of listeners worldwide. Our systems are responsible for how content is ingested, understood, enriched, governed, and distributed across the platform.

As the scale and diversity of content continue to grow—driven by advances in AI, new creation tools, and emerging content formats—we’re investing in intelligent systems that can understand, evaluate, manage, and route content reliably at global scale.

We’re hiring Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineers to build and scale foundational ML systems that power content understanding, safety, policy enforcement, and decisioning across Spotify. Depending on your experience and interests, you may focus on areas ranging from multimodal content understanding and platform-level ML systems to safety, risk detection, policy enforcement, and compliance.

You’ll help shape the architecture and technical strategy behind how Spotify understands and makes decisions about content at global scale. This work is foundational to delivering safe, high-quality experiences for listeners and creators while enabling new ways for people to interact with content across Spotify.

What You Will Do

- Define and drive machine learning strategy across content understanding, safety, policy enforcement, and platform-level decisioning

- Build and scale production ML systems for classification, moderation, ranking, risk detection, and content evaluation

- Develop automated decisioning systems that support content quality, integrity, safety, and policy compliance at scale

- Design and deploy ML systems across multiple content modalities, including text, audio, image, and video

- Build systems capable of evaluating and making decisions about content in real time and at Spotify scale

- Enable controlled and reliable access to content and metadata for downstream products and applications

- Collaborate closely with Product, Policy, Trust & Safety, and Engineering teams to translate content standards into scalable technical solutions

- Advance automation while maintaining high standards for quality, safety, fairness, explainability, and reliability

- Provide technical leadership across teams, mentoring engineers and influencing ML engineering, evaluation, and system design best practices
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- You have significant experience designing and building production-grade machine learning systems at scale

- You have deep experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, or similar

- You have experience with—or a strong interest in—multimodal machine learning across areas such as text, audio, image, or video

- You have built systems where machine learning outputs inform or automate real-world decisions

- You understand how to balance automation with quality, safety, reliability, and user experience

- You’re comfortable tackling complex and ambiguous technical problems with significant product and business impact

- You think in systems, connecting models, data, infrastructure, and decisioning to platform-level outcomes and user experiences

- You care deeply about data quality, rigorous evaluation, fairness, explainability, and system reliability

- You’re an experienced technical leader who communicates clearly, mentors others, and can influence across technical and non-technical teams

Where You Will Be

-

This role is based in New York.

-

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $281,196 - $401,709 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Financial Engineering - Tax Solutions
jobs.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

At Spotify, our Financial Engineering teams build and scale the internal systems that power global financial operations across a rapidly evolving business. Within the FinE Alliance, you’ll work closely with Tax, Treasury, Accounting, and Engineering partners to shape products that enable operational excellence, compliance, and automation at global scale. This role sits at the intersection of finance, product strategy, enterprise systems, and engineering, helping Spotify continuously improve how financial processes operate across regions and regulatory environments.

What You'll Do

- Partner closely with Tax teams to agree on vision, strategy and roadmap, as well as understand tax processes, compliance requirements, reporting needs, and risk areas.

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify’s tax technology ecosystem, balancing internal platform development with third-party SaaS solutions.

- Drive discovery, prioritization, and execution across financial engineering initiatives that support tax operations, treasury processes, and regulatory reporting.

- Translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into intuitive product experiences and actionable technical requirements.

- Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Platform, and Finance teams to deliver secure, scalable, and well-integrated solutions.

- Lead cross-functional conversations around trade-offs, dependencies, and long-term platform strategy while maintaining momentum on iterative delivery.

- Partner with external vendors and SaaS providers to ensure reliable integrations, system performance, and operational continuity.

- Build strong relationships across Finance leadership and become a trusted advisor on product direction, risks, and delivery planning.

- Improve visibility, controls, and data quality across tax-related systems and workflows.

- Champion user-centric product thinking while ensuring enterprise-grade governance, auditability, and scalability.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- You have experience building or managing products within accounting, tax technology, fintech, ERP, or enterprise financial systems environments.

- You are experienced partnering with Finance, Tax, Treasury, or Accounting stakeholders in global organizations.

- You know how to translate complex operational or compliance requirements into clear product strategies, roadmaps, and delivery plans.

- You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.

- You have experience working with SaaS platforms such as NetSuite, Vertex, Oracle, SAP, or similar enterprise financial systems.

- You have strong product management fundamentals, including backlog prioritization, product discovery, roadmap planning, and iterative delivery.

- You care deeply about building scalable systems with reliable controls, integrations, and high-quality user experiences.

- You are an excellent communicator who can simplify technical and financial complexity for different audiences.

- You have experience working in hybrid technology environments that combine vendor platforms with internally built systems.

- You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and enjoy solving operational challenges through technology.

Where You'll Be

- This role is based in London or Stockholm.

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.title: Lead Music Development, Türkiye
jobs.description:
The Lead, Music Development acts as the principal architect in fortifying Spotify’s relationships and standing within the Turkish music landscape across labels, industry bodies, and other institutional stakeholders. Acting as the spokesperson, this role strengthens Spotify’s position in the Turkish music ecosystem by shaping clear narratives and leading strategic initiatives and events. You will address industry sentiment, focus on strengthening institutional relationships, and connect with internal global music leadership to ensure a seamless flow of information and feedback.

What You'll Do

- Build and lead relationships with major and independent labels, CMOs, and key music industry partners across Türkiye

- Drive strategic alignment through initiatives like Quarterly Business Reviews, focusing on long-term growth and shared outcomes

- Represent Spotify as a trusted voice in the Turkish music ecosystem through events, panels, and industry forums

- Shape and deliver clear, compelling narratives that communicate Spotify’s platform, values, and innovations

- Partner with Marketing, PR, Government Affairs, and global Music teams to align communication and engagement strategies

- Provide local teams with insights on market trends, emerging genres, and shifts in listener behavior

- Translate market data into actionable strategies that support artists, partners, and business growth

- Design and lead education initiatives that help partners better understand Spotify’s tools, model, and opportunities

- Define and deliver initiatives that support the growth, diversity, and global reach of Turkish music

- Manage budgets to execute impactful programs across the local music ecosystem
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- You have a minimum of 15 years of experience across media, entertainment, or technology, with exposure to rights, partnerships, or content strategy

- You understand how the digital music ecosystem works, including streaming models and platform dynamics

- You know how to build and maintain senior-level relationships across complex stakeholder environments

- You are comfortable representing an organization publicly and can communicate complex ideas in a clear, engaging way

- You use market insights and data to guide decisions and influence strategy

- You collaborate effectively across global teams and can balance local priorities with broader business goals

- You communicate fluently in both Turkish and English, with confidence in formal presentations and discussions

- You bring a strong understanding of the Turkish music landscape, including regulatory and industry dynamics

- You care about supporting creators and contributing to a more inclusive and sustainable music ecosystem

Where You'll Be

- This role is based in Istanbul

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.title: Contractor Music Marketing Content Strategist (8-Month Cover)
jobs.description:
Spotify is looking for a Contractor Content Strategist to join our Korea Marketing team on an 8-month maternity leave cover. This role will help shape how Spotify tells stories around K-Music, artists and fandom by developing creative content ideas, scalable formats, and social-first storytelling approaches.

Working across Marketing, Music, Social & Content, Creative Production and global partners, the role will translate campaign objectives into compelling content ecosystems that resonate with Korean audiences while supporting Spotify's broader business goals.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally passionate about creative strategy, social culture, and content development—and enjoys turning ideas into repeatable formats that can scale across campaigns.

Please note this fixed-term role is employed through a third party.

What You'll Do

-

Develop content strategies and creative frameworks that support Spotify's K-Music marketing campaigns across owned and earned channels

-

Create scalable content formats and social-first concepts that can be adapted across multiple artists, campaigns and cultural moments

-

Partner closely with Marketing Managers to translate campaign objectives into engaging content plans

-

Collaborate with Producers and external production partners to ensure creative ideas are executed effectively

-

Work cross-functionally with Korea Music, Social & Content, Creative Production and global marketing teams to develop culturally relevant storytelling

-

Identify emerging content trends, platform behaviors and fan culture across K-Music, proactively bringing new creative opportunities into Spotify's content strategy

-

Help build repeatable content playbooks and best practices that strengthen Spotify's long-term content ecosystem

-

Contribute to both on-platform and off-platform content experiences that deepen fan engagement and strengthen Spotify's cultural relevance
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

-

5–7 years of experience in content strategy, creative strategy, social media, branded content, entertainment marketing, or a related field

-

Proven experience developing content ideas, formats or creative concepts that drive audience engagement

-

Deep understanding of social platforms, creator culture, and how audiences consume content across different channels

-

Able to think beyond individual campaigns and develop scalable content systems and repeatable creative frameworks

-

Strong collaborator who can bridge creative, production and marketing teams

-

Comfortable working from creative ideation through execution alongside producers and agency partners

-

Passionate about K-Music, including K-Pop and the broader Korean music landscape, with a strong understanding of fandom culture and what resonates with audiences

-

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly in cross-functional and global environments

-

Experience in music, entertainment, media, agencies or digital platforms is a strong plus

Where You'll Be

- This role is based in Seoul, Korea

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Data Platform
jobs.description:
Within the Data Platform studio, we own two critical pillars: our event delivery platform that collects trillions of events per day from producers to consumers, and another, which handles the pseudonymisation of data so Spotify can use data responsibly and in compliance with privacy regulations. These systems sit at the heart of Spotify's data collection and are used by hundreds of teams across the company.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of six experienced engineers distributed across Europe. You'll set the technical direction, ensure the team delivers high-impact work, and - just as importantly - invest deeply in the growth and careers of your engineers. If you're energised by both the technical challenges of large-scale data systems and the human side of building a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

- Lead and develop a team of six experienced engineers, with a strong focus on coaching, career development, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers.

- Take accountability for the team's delivery, ensuring clear priorities, healthy execution, and measurable outcomes.

- Partner with product and stakeholders to shape the roadmap for event delivery and privacy infrastructure.

- Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions for systems operating at Spotify scale.

- Build a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.

- Collaborate across Data Platform and the wider engineering organisation to align on shared goals and dependencies.

- Manage on-call health, operational excellence, and reliability for the team's services.

- Actively participate in hiring, onboarding, and growing the team's capabilities.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- You have experience managing teams of senior/experienced engineers and understand that people leadership is your primary craft, not a side responsibility.

- You have a track record of investing in engineers' careers - running meaningful development conversations, helping people grow into new roles, and creating clarity around expectations and progression.

- You're comfortable with distributed data systems, event-driven architectures, or data infrastructure at scale - you don't need to write the code, but you can engage credibly in technical discussions and unblock your team.

- You hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes, not just activity.

- You communicate clearly and build trust across functions and time zones.

- You've worked with distributed teams and understand how to create cohesion and inclusion when people aren't in the same room.

- You're excited about the potential of AI and LLMs to transform how engineering teams work - whether that's accelerating development workflows, rethinking how data infrastructure is built and operated, or helping your team adopt AI-assisted tooling effectively.

Where You’ll Be

- This role is based in London.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Financial Engineering
jobs.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Spotify's Financial Engineering (FinE) organization ensures that as Spotify grows, our financial systems grow with it. We build the infrastructure and tooling that finance teams across the company depend on to track revenue accurately, report reliably, and reconcile at scale.

The Oracles team sits at the heart of Spotify's financial infrastructure, building the data pipelines and backend services that power our subledger and accounting lifecycle. As part of a broader Financial Engineering initiative, we're standardizing and scaling how accounting data flows across Spotify. You'll partner with engineers, finance teams, and product managers to build reliable, scalable systems that simplify complex financial processes.

We're looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys building reliable, data-intensive systems. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Policy & Safety
jobs.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Policy & Safety team sits within Content Platform in the Experience Mission, building the systems that keep Spotify safe, compliant, and trusted by millions of users and creators. This team owns Spotify’s content moderation infrastructure — from detection models to policy enforcement systems and compliance data pipelines.

Working at the intersection of machine learning, platform engineering, and regulatory compliance, the team partners closely with Trust & Safety, Legal, and Public Affairs. They’re on the critical path for every new content type and social feature — including messaging, comments, and collaborative experiences — ensuring safety is built in from day one. Design, build, and ship production-grade machine learning systems that power content safety and policy enforcement at Spotify scale

Represent technical decisions and trade-offs in stakeholder discussions and influence product direction

jobs.title: Product Designer - Advertising
jobs.description:
Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators.

Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity — giving a million artists the opportunity to live off their art, and billions of fans the chance to be inspired by it. Spotify Advertising supports this mission by helping brands connect with listeners through meaningful, effective ad experiences.

This is a pivotal moment for Spotify Advertising. As we scale globally and evolve into a performance-focused, AI-powered platform, design plays a central role in simplifying complex systems, building trust with advertisers, and driving scalable product growth. Our long-term vision is an intuitive platform embedded in advertiser workflows, powered by automation, measurement, and operational excellence.

We're looking for a mid-level product designer to join our Advertising R&D team. You'll own design quality and cohesion across a set of features in Spotify's advertiser-facing tools, working on high-priority areas including campaign creation, audience targeting, reporting, optimization, creative tooling, measurement, and internal platforms. If you enjoy solving complex problems alongside cross-functional partners and are comfortable navigating ambiguous, technical domains (including AI, automation, and experimentation), we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

- Design end-to-end user experiences across Spotify's self-serve advertising platform (Ads Manager), contributing to features like ad creation, targeting, reporting, optimization, and measurement.

- Work within and contribute to a shared design system used across Ads Manager and internal tools, with attention to component reusability, accessibility, and visual consistency.

- Collaborate with engineers to translate backend systems, APIs, and ML-powered features into interfaces that are intuitive and performant.

- Partner with PMs, engineers, data scientists, researchers, and content designers to shape product direction, advocate for user needs, and help influence your team's roadmap.

- Work alongside researchers and data scientists to identify the right questions to answer, and use insights to deepen your team's understanding of user problems.

- Support design efforts on internal tools used by operational teams, helping reduce manual processes and improve the efficiency and reliability of internal workflows.

- Contribute to a feedback-rich team culture that values critique, iteration, and craft excellence.

jobs.title: Head of Backstage Marketing
jobs.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

About the Team
Backstage was created at Spotify and has grown into a leading SaaS and open source platform for developer portals. Thousands of companies use Backstage to bring structure to complex microservices environments, improve developer experience, and ship high-quality software faster — including in the age of AI — without losing autonomy or control.Backstage powers centralized software catalogs, standards, and AI enablement capabilities across open source, plugins, and SaaS offerings.

Our customers include global enterprises and Fortune 100 companies transforming their engineering culture. This role leads marketing for Shipping Our Expertise (SOE), Spotify’s B2B SaaS business built on our platform capabilities, while also shaping the broader Spotify R&D brand.

What You'll Do

- Set and drive the end-to-end marketing strategy for the SOE business across product marketing, growth, and brand

- Build and execute growth strategies that drive measurable revenue, adoption, and customer expansion

- Lead digital and paid acquisition programs targeting developers, engineering leaders, and enterprise buyers

- Define clear positioning and differentiated messaging for technical B2B audiences

- Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Sales to align roadmap, go-to-market plans, and commercial priorities

- Establish and track full-funnel performance across awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue

- Lead event and community strategy to increase visibility and generate qualified pipeline

- Scale marketing operations through strong planning, dashboards, and performance reporting

- Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing, data-informed marketing team
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- You have 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, growth marketing, or product marketing

- You have 5+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing teams

- You have experience marketing developer tools, infrastructure platforms, or technical SaaS products

- You understand engineering culture and know how to communicate with technical audiences

- You have owned revenue or adoption targets and can demonstrate measurable business impact

- You have led digital performance marketing, paid acquisition, and growth funnel optimization

- You are comfortable working with data, building forecasts, and using dashboards to guide decisions

- You balance commercial thinking with strong product intuition and user-centered mindset

- You bring structure and clarity to complex, ambiguous initiatives

- You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy building new approaches from the ground up

Where You'll Be

- This role is based in Toronto

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.title: Associate Client Partner - Emerging & Scaled (New Business, German Speaking)
jobs.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts.

The Emerging & Scaled team is focused on unlocking growth from new and growing advertisers across Spotify’s ads business. The New Business team brings first-time advertisers onto the platform and builds the foundation for long-term partnerships. Germany is a key market within our Northern Europe E&S organization. Based in London, you will partner closely with our existing German Client Partners and Sales leadership to build a dedicated New Business pipeline and expand Spotify’s advertiser base across Germany.

This role focuses on new business acquisition. You will source, qualify, and close net-new advertisers, building relationships from scratch and converting first-time buyers into long-term Spotify partners. Reporting to the Head of E&S Europe, you will be part of a dedicated cross-market New Business team focused on net-new advertiser acquisition and revenue growth across Europe.

You’re motivated, proactive, and energized by building new relationships.. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how new advertisers discover Spotify and elevate their connection to our platform.

What You'll Do

• New Business Acquisition: Own a portfolio of prospective accounts across the German market, proactively identifying, qualifying, and converting net-new advertisers into active Spotify partners through proactive outbound prospecting.

• Outreach & Prospecting: Execute multi-channel outreach motions including account research, persona mapping, personalized email sequences, and LinkedIn engagement. Create and leverage mockups (audio, video, display) to drive responsiveness and first-time advertiser adoption.

• Pipeline Management: Maintain a healthy pipeline with rigorous Salesforce hygiene, accurate forecasting, and consistent meeting cadence. Drive toward quarterly net-new revenue targets and advertiser onboarding milestones.

• Client Activation: Close deals and onboard new advertisers, ensuring strong activation on Spotify Ads Manager and biddable channels. Monitor account performance after activation.

• Collaboration & Handoffs: Partner with existing accounts that are lapsed or dormant, and build new top-of-funnel pipeline opportunities. Collaborate with existing Client Partners to ensure smooth account transitions when accounts graduate beyond New Business thresholds.

• Product Expertise: Develop deep expertise in Spotify’s ad products, formats, and buying channels. Stay ahead of product innovations and monitor marketplace shifts to continuously refine your prospecting approach.

• Market Development: Build relationships with key agencies and holding companies in Germany to unlock new brand-direct and agency-led opportunities.
jobs.requirements_raw:

• Hunter Mentality: You have 4+ years of experience in digital media sales minimum, ideally in a New Business or acquisition-focused role. You excel at cold outreach, account mapping, competitive research, and crafting personalized messaging that drives response.

• Organized & Self-Reliant: You independently manage a high-volume book of prospective accounts with confidence, prioritizing engagements with efficiency.

• Articulate: You are an effective communicator, clearly articulating Spotify’s value proposition and understanding client business needs.

• Intrinsically Motivated: You are driven by your own goals and always aim to beat your personal best. You thrive on building something new.

• Commercially Driven: You thrive on exceeding targets and making a tangible impact. Experience in ad tech, programmatic, or audio advertising is a plus.

jobs.title: Manager, Growth Creative Strategy & Optimization - Markets & Subscribers
jobs.description:
We’re the Markets & Subscribers business unit, a truly cross-functional team focused on finding future listeners, wherever and whoever they may be. We work collaboratively, combining marketing, insights, product development, design, and engineering expertise to grow Spotify’s subscribers and monthly active users in both new and existing markets across the globe. Join us and you’ll be part of a dynamic team taking acquisition, activation, and business growth at Spotify to the next level.

Spotify is looking for a Manager, Growth Creative Strategy & Optimization to own the full creative process across performance and lifecycle marketing. This is a senior individual contributor role — you’ll be the creative center of gravity for both the Performance Marketing team (off-platform paid acquisition channels) and the Lifecycle Marketing team (on-platform organic acquisition channels). The ideal person for this role has a strong background in DR creative, is fluent in creative testing and optimization, and can manage end-to-end creative production while translating data into actionable creative strategies.

What You'll Do

- Lead end-to-end creative development for Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat), Google (Demand Gen, Google App Campaigns), CTV, and lifecycle marketing channels from brief through final asset delivery, ensuring all creative is on-brand and optimized for conversion

- Build and maintain a creative review framework that defines who reviews what, at which stage, and against which criteria, creating clarity and consistency across teams

- Advocate for creative quality, going beyond brand guideline compliance to support work that is compelling, differentiated, and built to perform

- Develop a POV on creative volume and testing — how much creative is needed, what should be tested, and what is driving impact vs. generating noise

- Build an annual creative roadmap of themes, priorities, and focus areas that aligns both teams around a shared creative strategy and reduces reactive production

- Analyze creative performance metrics (CTR, CVR, CPA, etc.) to identify effective patterns and surface opportunities for improvement

- Synthesize test results into clear, actionable creative briefs and iteration roadmaps, and communicate findings to stakeholders across both teams

- Identify and implement automation and AI tools across the creative workflow, establishing a clear framework for where and when they should be used vs. where human creative judgment is essential

- Stay ahead of platform-specific creative best practices and emerging formats, and proactively incorporate them into the creative playbook

- Collaborate with media buyers and growth managers to ensure creative is aligned with investment strategy, platform algorithms, and audience targeting
jobs.requirements_raw:

- You have a track record of developing creative at scale across multiple markets and languages that drives measurable performance outcomes across paid and owned channels

- You are familiar with platform-specific creative specs and best practices across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and Google

- You bring strong creative instincts and a high bar for quality, and can provide clear, constructive feedback

- You think in systems and have built or improved creative workflows, review processes, or operating frameworks

- You are comfortable working with data and can interpret creative metrics and contribute to a test-and-learn framework with a clear point of view

- You are comfortable using AI tools to support creative production, improve efficiency, and scale output

jobs.title: Product & Regulatory Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Spotify’s Legal team is growing. We’re facing innovative challenges that mirror the ground-breaking industry and product at the heart of our company. As we’ve expanded into more than 184 countries and our company has grown tremendously, we find ourselves facing new and interesting legal issues every day.

Legal Affairs sits at the heart of this mission, ensuring that Spotify meets its obligations under an evolving global regulatory landscape while championing user safety, transparency, and trust.

Spotify’s Product & Regulatory team within Legal Affairs leads the company’s global approach to digital-platform regulation. We drive the operational backbone of Spotify's approach to digital-platform regulation—managing the workflows, documentation, and cross-functional coordination needed to comply with laws like the EU Digital Markets Act (DMA), EU Digital Services Act (DSA), the UK Online Safety Act (UK OSA), the Australian Online Safety Act (AUS OSA), and similar frameworks worldwide. Working closely with Legal stakeholders, Trust & Safety, Public Policy, Product, Design, and Engineering, we turn regulatory requirements into well-managed processes and keep them on track.

We’re looking for a resourceful operator who can own the day-to-day machinery of our product and regulatory compliance work—document management, regulatory monitoring, terms updates, and cross-functional special projects. If you’re a self-starter who thrives on bringing order to complexity and keeping programs moving, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

- Own and improve document management for the product and regulatory team—organizing compliance records, maintaining regulatory filing systems, and ensuring the team can find what it needs fast.

- Build and maintain regulatory monitoring practices—tracking legislative developments, managing regulatory calendars, and surfacing changes that matter to the team.

- Manage terms-of-service and policy update processes end-to-end—coordinating drafts, cross-functional reviews, approvals, and publication timelines.

- Project-manage special projects and cross-functional initiatives for the Product & Regulatory Legal team, driving workstreams from kick-off to close with clear milestones and owners.

- Support responses to regulatory requests for information (RFIs) and audits—pulling together materials, coordinating inputs across teams, and ensuring timely, accurate submissions.

- Develop and maintain internal playbooks, process documentation, and communications that keep compliance workflows running without bottlenecks.

- Coordinate with Product, Trust & Safety, and Engineering to keep operational controls and reporting processes on track across active regulatory programs.

- Identify operational gaps and drive continuous improvement in how the team manages its regulatory workload.

jobs.description:
Spotify’s Legal team is growing. We’re facing innovative challenges that mirror the ground-breaking industry and product at the heart of our company. As we’ve expanded into more than 184 countries and our company has grown tremendously, we find ourselves facing new and interesting legal issues every day.

You will also work directly to resolve claims related to these policies and help build out processes for scale. Your experience making risk-based assessments and proactively finding solutions to complex problems will be crucial.

What You'll Do

- Advise on Spotify’s global compliance with platform liability frameworks and content safe harbor laws (e.g., Digital Services Act, DMCA, Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act)

- Support managing Spotify’s legal takedown process, across content types, across all types of legal issues including intellectual property and speech-based offenses

- Provide legal advice across Spotify on platform liability, including issue-spotting and strategizing solutions for exciting new products

- Counsel the teams responsible for building, managing, and implementing Spotify’s content policies, including the Trust & Safety team and the Content Protection team

- Perform rotational work as business requires

- 5+ years of experience working in a law firm and/or in-house legal department

- Experience assessing and advising on a broad set of legal standards, even when those standards are new to you

- A passion for legal problems; you can explain legal concepts to non-lawyers

jobs.title: Manager, Proposition Strategy
jobs.description:
Spotify’s Propositions team is responsible for what we offer and how we package it — the plans, tiers, and propositions that shape how hundreds of millions of people experience and pay for Spotify. As Manager - Proposition Strategy, you’ll help define how Spotify grows its next billion users by developing affordable, locally relevant propositions, evolving existing tiers, and identifying new opportunities that can unlock sustainable growth.

This is a role for someone who thinks in business cases as much as ideas. You’ll take work from an initial hypothesis through to an executive-ready recommendation — building the economics, assessing margin and licensing implications, modeling cannibalization risk, and creating a clear narrative for senior leaders. You’ll work closely with Strategy, Finance, Product, Legal, and Market teams, and your work will directly influence the propositions Spotify brings to some of the world’s fastest-growing markets.

What You'll Do

- Develop new proposition opportunities and evolve existing subscription tiers, grounding recommendations in strong commercial thinking and local market realities.

- Own the full journey from initial hypothesis to executive recommendation, including opportunity sizing, unit economics, margin and licensing analysis, cannibalization modeling, and the final narrative.

- Build and stress-test business cases that account for Spotify’s licensing structure, local market dynamics, currency considerations, and subscriber economics.

- Identify and quantify potential cannibalization across existing tiers and revenue streams, including the relationship between free, lower-cost, and standard offerings in price-sensitive markets.

- Partner closely with Finance, Product, Legal, Strategy, and Market teams to challenge assumptions, build alignment, and shape clear recommendations.

- Monitor competitive, consumer, and macroeconomic developments to identify opportunities and risks that should inform the proposition roadmap.

- Turn complex analysis into clear choices and recommendations that help senior leaders make informed decisions.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- You have experience in product strategy, management consulting, corporate strategy, business development, or a related area, with a track record of turning ambiguous questions into structured recommendations.

- You are comfortable building and owning complex financial models, including unit economics, margin analysis, scenario modeling, and cannibalization frameworks.

- You understand the dynamics of high-growth consumer markets and have experience working across different markets or geographies.

- You can translate complex commercial trade-offs into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences.

- You work effectively across functions and levels, building alignment while constructively challenging assumptions.

- You balance analytical rigor with sound judgment and are comfortable moving between detailed analysis and broader strategic thinking.

- You are curious about markets where established playbooks may not apply and enjoy finding practical paths through uncertainty.

Where You'll Be

- This role can based in New York or London.

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $147,133–$210,191, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. jobs.title: Manager FP&A, Distribution Partnerships
jobs.description:
Spotify is looking for a commercially minded FP&A Manager to serve as the dedicated finance partner for our Distribution Partnerships team. Distribution Partnerships play an important role in Spotify's growth strategy by working with strategic partners to expand user acquisition, deepen engagement, and improve retention through innovative distribution and marketing initiatives.

In this role, you'll build the financial foundations that help shape partnership decisions. You'll develop robust business cases, subscriber models, and end-to-end P&L analyses that connect user growth with business outcomes. You'll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, challenge assumptions, and provide insights that help leaders make confident, data-informed decisions.

What You'll Do

- Lead business case development for Distribution Partnerships by building investment models that combine subscriber forecasts, partnership economics, and full P&L impact.

- Develop financial frameworks that evaluate new and existing partnerships, including lifetime value, payback periods, return on investment, and other key performance metrics.

- Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks that inform partnership strategy and investment decisions.

- Partner closely with Distribution Partnerships, Accounting, Business Affairs, Legal, Strategy, and other cross-functional teams to translate financial insights into clear recommendations for business and senior leaders.

- Build, maintain, and continuously improve reporting for the partnership portfolio, including KPIs, performance tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis.

- Support annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and ongoing financial planning activities by partnering with business leaders to establish data-driven targets.

- Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, and tooling to help Spotify evaluate and manage partnerships more effectively.
jobs.requirements_raw:

- You have 5+ years of experience in FP&A, Strategy & Analytics, Investment Banking, Corporate Finance, or a similar analytical role. Experience in a consumer subscription business is a plus.

- You have experience building sophisticated financial models and performing scenario analysis in environments with evolving information and changing priorities.

- You know how to translate commercial agreements into meaningful financial outcomes and have experience partnering with Legal, Business Affairs, commercial, or deal teams.

- You are comfortable working with large datasets. Experience with SQL is preferred, and you are interested in applying AI tools to improve financial analysis and decision-making.

- You balance strong attention to detail with sound judgment, knowing when additional analysis will meaningfully improve a decision and when it is time to move forward.

- You manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining a high standard of quality in a fast-moving environment.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions Mission
jobs.description:
Mission Statement
The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

About the Team
This role sits at the heart of the Subscriptions Mission and owns how users move through the freemium funnel — from the moment a free user encounters Premium value, through trial, conversion, activation, and into long-term retention. You’ll partner closely with product, design, marketing, finance, pricing & packaging, and regional commercial teams to shape the end-to-end subscriber journey across plans and markets.

What You'll Do

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for the freemium-to-Premium funnel, improving conversion, trial-to-paid, ARPU, and long-term retention

- Shape subscription plans and portfolio in partnership with Pricing & Packaging, including tiers, durations, and regional pricing strategies

- Lead discovery, design, and delivery of subscriber-facing features from concept through global rollout

- Run lifecycle and monetization experiments across trials, win-back, upgrades, payment recovery, and retention flows

- Design and evaluate A/B experiments, scaling solutions that deliver measurable impact

- Balance trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, and operational complexity

- Partner with Finance, BizOps, and regional teams to localize plans, offers, and messaging

- Communicate strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions
jobs.description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

What You Will Do

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for how free users become aware of, experience, and develop intent for Premium, driving consideration, conversion intent, and subscriber growth across segments and markets.

- Lead the discovery, design, and delivery of subscriber-facing features from early concept through global rollout.

- Drive experiments that deepen our understanding of what makes users want Premium and measurably move free users closer to a purchase decision.

- Turn behavioral, funnel, and market data into clear hypotheses, define meaningful success metrics, and build a prioritized experimentation roadmap.

- Design rigorous A/B experiments to evaluate funnel changes against strong baselines, scaling approaches that demonstrably work across markets and segments.

- Make pragmatic trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, regional nuance, and operational complexity, knowing when a simple flow change is enough and when a deeper platform capability is needed.

- Partner with marketing, research, and regional teams to adapt value positioning and messaging for different markets, competitive landscapes, and user needs, including high-growth emerging markets where the path to Premium may look fundamentally different.

- Communicate strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders, translating funnel mechanics and subscription economics into business impact and strategic direction.

Where You'll Be

- You have a strong track record in product management and have shipped consumer-facing products or features at scale, with experience that translates well to subscription, marketplace, consumer growth, or media environments.

- You have strong instincts for consumer value and what makes a product feel worth paying for, and understand how perception, positioning, and product experience work together to influence willingness to pay.

- You can break down the path from awareness to conversion, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and connect product decisions to downstream revenue outcomes such as ARPU, LTV, and net subscriber growth.

- You're fluent in experimentation and A/B testing and are confident interpreting funnel, cohort, and behavioral analysis to make thoughtful prioritization decisions.

- You know how to navigate the complexity of a global consumer business across different segments, markets, and competitive dynamics, balancing global consistency with local relevance.

- You bring strong judgment about when to optimize, when to invest more deeply, and when to leave something alone, balancing user value, revenue impact, and operational cost.

- You're a clear communicator and collaborative partner across product, design, engineering, marketing, research, data science, and regional teams, and you can align people around shared outcomes.

- You're comfortable working through open-ended problems, learning quickly through experimentation, and adapting your approach based on evidence.

Where You Will Be

- This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden.

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration.

Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.

What You'll Do

- Collaborate with a highly autonomous and supportive engineering squad responsible for Spotify’s delegated authorization and session management platforms.

- Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.

- Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.

- Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.

- Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.

- Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.

- Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.

jobs.title: Director, Portfolio & Monetization Architecture
jobs.description:
Spotify's growth depends on offering the right thing to the right listener at the right price, moving beyond one-size-fits-all packaging toward a portfolio where listeners can mix and match what they value most. The evolution of our subscription portfolio, and how we monetize it, is one of Spotify’s most important strategic opportunities in the years ahead.

We’re looking for a Director to lead the strategic design of that portfolio end to end, shaping the architecture of tiers, add-ons, bundles, and the broader pricing ecosystem. This role will help define how the portfolio works today and how it evolves over the coming years to better serve listeners while driving sustainable growth.

As the strategic engine behind our portfolio architecture, you’ll combine commercial intuition, consumer understanding, behavioral data, and real-world market signals to build conviction behind critical decisions. Working closely with cross-functional partners and senior leaders, you’ll help determine what belongs in Premium, what moves into new monetization layers, and how Spotify’s subscription offering continues to evolve for millions of listeners around the world.

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including tier structure, add-ons, bundles, and how features are allocated across them.

- Set the logic of the price ladder, including relative pricing, upgrade paths, and how regional ladders work across developed and emerging markets.

- Drive the insight agenda with Consumer Insights and Analytics, shaping hypotheses, sequencing research, and translating findings into clear portfolio strategy recommendations.

- Partner with GTM Enablement and cross-functional teams to design, read, and apply in-market tests that connect consumer research with real behavior.

- Build the business case for portfolio decisions, including sizing, contribution logic, trade-offs, and long-term commercial impact.

- Drive alignment across Product, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Licensing, and senior leadership on key architecture decisions.

- Influence the product roadmap so what gets built reflects willingness-to-pay signals, consumer needs, and portfolio strategy.

- Own the multi-year evolution of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including where the portfolio should sit two-to-three years out and the sequence of moves to get there.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- You have deep commercial strategy experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, subscriptions, or consumer businesses.

- You think structurally and can reason across an entire packaging-and-pricing system, not just a single product, feature, or number.

- You have strong intuition for consumer behavior and behavioral economics, including how people perceive value, compare tiers, and make purchase decisions.

- You have a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and building cross-functional consensus without direct authority.

- You can move fluently between consumer language and commercial logic, and you are comfortable being the voice of the consumer in strategic discussions.

- You have experience with Good-Better-Best architectures, feature gating, add-ons, bundles, or regional price laddering.

- You may bring experience from strategy consulting, product strategy, corporate strategy, pricing, consumer tech, media, or subscription businesses.

- Familiarity with content or rights licensing, and how it shapes product packaging, would be valuable.

Where You'll Be

- This role is based in New York or Stockholm.

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description:
Content Platform is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and delivering every piece of content on Spotify — from music and podcasts to audiobooks. Within Content Platform, the Media domain owns the end-to-end media pipeline, from the moment content arrives through to seamless playback for listeners around the world. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to provide architectural leadership across this media platform. You’ll help shape and drive the technical direction from ingestion through transcoding, packaging, storage, delivery, and playback. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, understands the trade-offs between codec choices and infrastructure costs, and can drive technical strategy across multiple teams at scale.

What You'll Do

- Partner closely with engineering managers, product managers, and senior engineers to align technical strategy with product priorities, reliability goals, and cost efficiency, acting as a key technical counterpart for media architecture.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Enrichment & Content Intelligence
jobs.description:
The Experience team designs Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Enrichment & Content Intelligence team sits within Content Platform in the Experience Mission. We build the metadata-resolution and content-enrichment infrastructure that powers how Spotify understands music and video content at global scale. Our systems help answer foundational questions across the platform: which tracks are the same recording, which music videos match which audio tracks, who wrote and performed a song, and how content relationships connect across Spotify’s catalog.

Our infrastructure powers products and experiences used by millions of listeners, artists, and creators every day. From recommendations and charts to royalties and artist tooling, the work we do directly shapes how content is understood and surfaced across Spotify.

We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help evolve the machine learning systems behind Recording Groups, Music Video Resolution, SongDNA, and the Music Knowledge Graph. This role sits at the intersection of multimodal machine learning, entity resolution, and production-scale engineering, with opportunities to work across audio, video, and metadata understanding problems at massive scale.

What You'll Do

- Own and evolve large-scale ML pipelines powering Spotify’s content-resolution systems

- Lead development of multimodal embedding frameworks supporting multimodal understanding, music video matching, SongDNA

- Improve entity-resolution systems across music and video content, helping Spotify better understand relationships between recordings, versions, and content formats

- Design and run experiments to improve precision, recall, and overall content-quality outcomes using offline evaluation, golden datasets, A/B testing, and impact analysis

- Build scalable ML evaluation and monitoring infrastructure, including standardized datasets, retraining workflows, and continuous improvement systems

- Contribute to the evolution of the Music Knowledge Graph by improving production ML capabilities, observability, and model lifecycle management

- Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and engineering teams across Content Platform and the wider Experience Mission

- Help shape technical strategy for the squad and contribute to long-term ML direction across the product area

- Mentor engineers and contribute to a strong culture of technical collaboration and experimentation
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- You have solid experience building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning systems in production at scale

- You have strong experience training, evaluating, and operating ML models using modern frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

- You have experience working with multimodal machine learning systems across audio, computer vision, text embeddings, or related domains

- You understand entity resolution, deduplication, record linkage, or large-scale matching problems, ideally across multiple content modalities

- You know how to design evaluation systems that balance model quality, operational performance, and real-world impact

- You are experienced working with large-scale distributed data processing systems and ML infrastructure

- You communicate effectively across engineering, product, and data science stakeholders

- You are comfortable leading technical initiatives and influencing engineering direction within a team

- Experience with Scio, Dataflow, Flyte, BigQuery, or similar distributed processing frameworks is a plus

- Experience with Scala is a plus

- Experience with computer vision, video understanding, multimodal embeddings, or recommendation systems is a strong plus

Where You'll Be

- This role is based in New York City

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
